title: Tangy Tofu Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry made with crispy tofu, sweet and tangy sauce, and a variety of vegetables.

ingredients.name: stir-fry vegetables (bok choy, bell peppers, carrots)

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and cook until tender-crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sweet and tangy sauce and bhuna.
Pour the sauce mixture over the tofu and vegetables, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
